camera: Flat top-down cartographic map view filling the whole screen, no perspective; flat front-facing UI on top.

hudLayout.topThird: Top-left corner: a crimson chunky square back button with a white '<' chevron. The map fills the screen edge to edge: flat tan sea and a half-step darker tan landmass drawn in dark ink. Widely letter-spaced serif small-capital region labels sit on the map along curves: 'HAUNTED FLATLANDS' arcing across the top, 'SLUMBERING HIGHLANDS' and 'MOUNT HINTERLANDS' (cropped at left as 'OUNT HINTERLANDS') around rows of chevron mountain strokes, 'IRONWOOD' small at left.
hudLayout.middleThird: Diagonal line hatching over rough terrain, thin wavering rivers, a dashed route 'OLD KINGS ROAD', the coastline label 'SYLVIR COAST', 'ROCKY COAST' running vertically on the right, small island at right. Small grey stone castle and tower markers with a purple shadow mark dungeon locations scattered over the land. Centre at ~44-48%: a dark charcoal label box 'HOME' in white bold caps, with an amber map pin with a white '!' beneath it pointing at a castle on the Sylvir Coast. 'BRENUMN BAY' in larger italic serif in the sea at left; 'FEI' cropped at the right edge.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Islands in Brenumn Bay with three castle markers; a long peninsula running down-right labelled 'GOLDEN KEY' and 'DRAGON CHAIN MNTS' with a castle marker. Bottom ~89-99%: a scale-bar legend with four rows, each a cropped letter at the left edge ('D', 'ER', 'A', 'R'), a dot, a long ink-segmented bar, and small caps text 'IO HOUR DAYS', 'IO HOUR DAYS', '24 HOUR DAYS', 'HOURS'.

keyElements: monochrome ink-on-tan cartographic map filling the screen
spaced serif region labels (HAUNTED FLATLANDS, SLUMBERING HIGHLANDS, MOUNT HINTERLANDS, SYLVIR COAST, ROCKY COAST, BRENUMN BAY, GOLDEN KEY, DRAGON CHAIN MNTS)
'HOME' dark label with amber '!' pin at centre
four-row scale legend at the bottom
uiStyle: Only two UI pieces: a chunky crimson soft-slab back button and a flat charcoal label box with an amber pin; everything else is flat map linework. Castle markers are small flat grey sprites with a soft purple shadow.
colorPalette: Almost monochrome warm tan with dark brown-black ink; a single crimson accent top-left and an amber pin at centre; small cool grey-lilac markers.
mood: Exploratory and old-world — a traveller's map of a wide, dangerous land.
composition: The map fills the frame; the HOME label and pin at centre are the focal point, with region names guiding the eye around it.

content.homeMarker: HOME label with amber ! pin over a castle on the Sylvir Coast
content.markers: about 14 small grey castle and tower dungeon markers
